family_similarity.rule_override_policy: Optional per-rule specific/broad acceptance thresholds in family_identity_rules.json add a family-specific route while preserving the selected profile thresholds; rule thresholds cannot exceed search_max_evalue.

description: Sequence-derived adhesome membership and named-family classifier with held-out panel reporting

sequence_homology.algorithm: Use Stage 1 forward and reverse BLAST tabular evidence; do not compare query strings or use k-mer neighbours

include: Verified Pfam identity, copy number, score, E-value, profile coverage and relative position
FASTA motif identifiers, site count and position; external context excluded
forward/reverse BLAST hit identity, alignment length, query/subject coverage, bit score, E-value and reciprocal reference-pair count

SHA-256-verified calibration-positive CDD fragments, including family-unlabelled fragments; specific/non-specific/broad class, source family when mapped, accession, identity, bit score, inclusive-coordinate query/subject coverage, domain order and hit-copy count
Measurable sequence features from family_identity_rules.json: required-group presence/count/satisfaction, CDD pattern matches, domain order/copy constraints and configured length ranges
Boolean conditions and individual Pfam/CDD signature presence/copy counts parsed from specific() and broad() in schisto_pfam_cdd_reclassify.py; concurrent rule-signal counts only
exclude: post-hoc rule return values, tiers, rescue/assignment decisions, and orthogroup arguments
topology, orthology, localization and signal peptide fields from Stage 2 identity-rule features

training_policy.family_labels: unambiguous expected_families/trusted_family labels only; no audit assignments
training_policy.validation: evaluation only; no fitting or threshold selection
training_policy.probabilities: uncalibrated model votes; decision thresholds declared before validation
training_policy.cdd_reference_policy: Retain all SHA-256-verified CDD fragments from calibration-positive controls, whether or not a trusted family label maps; exclude validation-origin fragments; exclude same-protein calibration references during training
training_policy.identity_rule_feature_policy: Evaluate only sequence-supported identity-rule fields identically in calibration, validation and target prediction; do not use family labels, assignment decisions, topology, orthology, localization or signal peptide
training_policy.posthoc_sequence_rule_feature_policy: Parse only boolean conditions and sequence-signature tokens from the post-hoc specific() and broad() rules. Validation data remain evaluation-only; no post-hoc outputs or proposed labels enter fitting or features.
